## About Hologic

Hologic helps women around the world live healthier lives.

We develop innovative medical technologies that effectively detect, diagnose and treat health
conditions and raise the standard of care globally.

We know women face unique health challenges at every stage of life, and we are passionate about
being a force for good.

Hologic is propelled by the passion and courage of our people to make a difference and innovate in
all we do. We believe everyone should feel welcomed, valued and heard, because great ideas come from
a diversity of views and experiences. We are proud to create opportunities for those who want to
grow their careers while making the world a better, healthier place.

][83]


What starts in the lab matters everywhere. So we’re powering the people at the heart of it all: you.

From uncovering the next clinical breakthrough, to rapid and reliable sample analysis, to more
rigorous decision making—at Beckman Coulter we are providing actionable insights that inform
clinical decisions during critical moments. From the laboratory to the clinician to the patient,
together we are powering the moments that matter.

[Atlanta Women’s Obstetrics & Gynecology][131] is an all-female OBGYN practice [located in Midtown

100 Hospitals. We offer a full range of healthcare services for women of all ages including
preventative medicine, [gynecological][133] and [obstetrical][134] services, laboratory and
[ultrasound services][135] including 3D fetal ultrasounds. Our practice strives to exceed our
patient’s service expectations while offering exceptional medical care. We invite you to peruse our
website and look forward to the opportunity to exceed your expectations soon!

# The European Committee on Antimicrobial Susceptibility Testing - EUCAST

EUCAST is a scientific committee formed in 1997 and is jointly organized by [ESCMID][174],
[ECDC][175] and European national breakpoint committees. EUCAST develops antimicrobial
susceptibility testing methodology, interpretative criteria and guidance documents to aid clinical
decision making when treating infectious diseases. 

Further details about EUCAST and its subcommittees can be found in the sections at the top of the
webpage.

## Expert Diagnostic Care with a Human Connection

## Our Story

Hands-On Health Labs was founded on a simple principle: high-quality diagnostic healthcare should be
accessible, professional, and patient-centered.

We recognized the growing need for clinical excellence outside the traditional hospital setting, and
set out to bridge the gap between medical accuracy and personal convenience.

Our team consists of highly qualified, certified phlebotomists and medical professionals dedicated
to maintaining the highest industry standards.Every draw and specimen collection is handled with
clinical precision, utilizing state-of-the-art equipment to ensure lab-grade accuracy from the
comfort of your home or office.

## Our Mission

We strive to support our community with reliable, professional medical testing. By prioritizing
patient comfort and clinical clarity, we help you get the health insights you need quickly and
safely.

## Patient Stories

"I was anxious about the draw, but the technician was so professional and gentle that I barely felt
a thing. Plus, getting my results explained clearly the very next day gave me such peace of mind.
It’s clinical excellence in my own living room."

— Sarah Jenkins

communication that stood out. I knew exactly what to expect, and the results were delivered promptly
with helpful context. Truly a professional concierge experience."

— David Miller

and surprisingly comfortable. They walked me through everything, and the transparency of the results
reporting is exactly what I needed for my health journey."

— Elena Rodriguez

## Frequently asked questions

FAQs

### Do I need a doctor's order?

Some laboratory services require an order from a licensed healthcare provider. Contact us if you're
unsure.

### What areas do you serve?

We bring the lab to you! Based in Milwaukee, Hands-On Health Labs provides convenient mobile
specimen collection for homes, workplaces, assisted living facilities throughout southern Wisconsin.
We also travel to other areas by appointment. Contact us to see if we serve your location.

### What forms of payment do you accept?

We accept a variety of convenient payment methods, including major credit and debit cards (Visa,
Mastercard, American Express, and Discover), Apple Pay and cash. Payment is due at the time of
service unless other arrangements have been made.


If you have questions about payment options, please contact us before your appointment.

## About this site

Lab Tests Online UK is a non-commercial resource written by practising laboratory doctors and
scientists to help you understand the many clinical laboratory tests that are used in diagnosis,

# WELCOME TO MAURYA LABS

# ABOUT

Maurya Labs was setup in the year 1998 by Dr A.K.Sinha in the city of Purnia. In the year 2004
Maurya Labs got the first 3 part hemoanalyzer and in 2007 the first fully automatic Biochemistry
Analyzer. Today Maurya Labs uses only 5 part fully automatic hemoanalyzers at all its labs. Dr
Anurag Mohan joined Maurya Labs in the year 2014 and is the main driving force in the deployment of
digital technology at the Lab.

 

# QUALITY

Maurya Labs has always been in the forefront of bringing the latest and most advanced technology in
the country in the field of Pathology. All our machines are closed systems delivering highly
accurate reports. Maurya Labs got NABL accreditation in the year 2012. In the last 26 years Maurya
Labs has earned the trust of doctors and patients for the timely delivery of test results and the
reliability of these results.

 

# NETWORK

Maurya Labs is now present in Purnia, Katihar, Araria and Madhepura. Maurya Labs provides pathology
services at multiple hospitals across the country by establishing a lab within the hospital. We have
more than 25 collection centres across Bihar. The logistics for sample movement are managed in such
a manner that we can delivery same day results for most of the tests anywhere in the country.

## Private Blood Tests
## in London. No Waiting

Looking for **private blood tests in London**? Our CQC-registered clinic at 20 Old Brompton Road,
South Kensington (SW7) provides immediate access to comprehensive diagnostic testing. Skip the NHS
waiting lists, book your **private blood test** online and get results from 24 hours.

We offer the same **UKAS-accredited laboratory analysis** used by NHS hospitals, Harley Street
consultants, and leading private healthcare providers. Whether you need a routine [full blood
count][7], [thyroid function tests][8], [liver function tests][9], vitamin D levels, or specialist
hormone panels, all tests are available without a GP referral.

**How private blood testing works:** Book your appointment online, visit our South Kensington
clinic, have your blood drawn by an NMC-registered nurse, and receive your results securely via our
patient portal. Browse our [complete blood test directory][10] or explore [health screening
packages][11] for comprehensive assessments.

### Our Service Includes
* 1
  
  Professional Phlebotomy
  
  Blood draw by NMC-registered nurses in a clinical environment. £50 fee per visit (not per test).
* 2
  
  UKAS-Accredited Labs
  
  Samples analysed at ISO 15189 accredited laboratories for clinical accuracy.
* 3
  
  Self-Referral Access
  
  No GP letter needed. Book any test directly for your own health information.
* 4
  
  Secure Digital Results
  
  Results delivered via encrypted patient portal with clinical reference ranges.

**Important:** This is a diagnostic testing service only. We do not provide medical advice,
interpretation of results, or treatment. Please consult your GP or a specialist if you need clinical
guidance based on your results.

patient portal. Browse our [complete blood test directory][10] or explore [health screening
packages][11] for comprehensive assessments.

  Self-Referral Access

interpretation of results, or treatment. Please consult your GP or a specialist if you need clinical

our private blood testing service operates on a self-referral basis. This means you can book any

vitamin panels.

offer same-day and next-day blood test appointments at our South Kensington clinic, subject to

markers typically take 3-5 working days.

clean, clinical environment. We partner with TDL (The Doctors Laboratory), one of the UK's leading

providers across London. This ensures your results are accurate, reliable, and clinically

### [Reference Ranges and What They Mean][91]

A reference range is a set of values that includes upper and lower limits of a lab test based on a
group of otherwise healthy people. By comparing your test results with reference values, you and
your health care provider can see if any of your test results fall outside the range of expected
values and gain clues to help identify possible conditions or diseases.

# The European Committee on Antimicrobial Susceptibility Testing - EUCAST

EUCAST is a scientific committee formed in 1997 and is jointly organized by [ESCMID][174],
[ECDC][175] and European national breakpoint committees. EUCAST develops antimicrobial
susceptibility testing methodology, interpretative criteria and guidance documents to aid clinical
decision making when treating infectious diseases. 

Further details about EUCAST and its subcommittees can be found in the sections at the top of the
webpage.

# WELCOME TO MAURYA LABS

# ABOUT

Maurya Labs was setup in the year 1998 by Dr A.K.Sinha in the city of Purnia. In the year 2004
Maurya Labs got the first 3 part hemoanalyzer and in 2007 the first fully automatic Biochemistry
Analyzer. Today Maurya Labs uses only 5 part fully automatic hemoanalyzers at all its labs. Dr
Anurag Mohan joined Maurya Labs in the year 2014 and is the main driving force in the deployment of
digital technology at the Lab.

 

# QUALITY

Maurya Labs has always been in the forefront of bringing the latest and most advanced technology in
the country in the field of Pathology. All our machines are closed systems delivering highly
accurate reports. Maurya Labs got NABL accreditation in the year 2012. In the last 26 years Maurya
Labs has earned the trust of doctors and patients for the timely delivery of test results and the
reliability of these results.

 

# NETWORK

Maurya Labs is now present in Purnia, Katihar, Araria and Madhepura. Maurya Labs provides pathology
services at multiple hospitals across the country by establishing a lab within the hospital. We have
more than 25 collection centres across Bihar. The logistics for sample movement are managed in such
a manner that we can delivery same day results for most of the tests anywhere in the country.

## Private Blood Tests
## in London. No Waiting

Looking for **private blood tests in London**? Our CQC-registered clinic at 20 Old Brompton Road,
South Kensington (SW7) provides immediate access to comprehensive diagnostic testing. Skip the NHS
waiting lists, book your **private blood test** online and get results from 24 hours.

We offer the same **UKAS-accredited laboratory analysis** used by NHS hospitals, Harley Street
consultants, and leading private healthcare providers. Whether you need a routine [full blood
count][7], [thyroid function tests][8], [liver function tests][9], vitamin D levels, or specialist
hormone panels, all tests are available without a GP referral.

**How private blood testing works:** Book your appointment online, visit our South Kensington
clinic, have your blood drawn by an NMC-registered nurse, and receive your results securely via our
patient portal. Browse our [complete blood test directory][10] or explore [health screening
packages][11] for comprehensive assessments.

### Our Service Includes
* 1
  
  Professional Phlebotomy
  
  Blood draw by NMC-registered nurses in a clinical environment. £50 fee per visit (not per test).
* 2
  
  UKAS-Accredited Labs
  
  Samples analysed at ISO 15189 accredited laboratories for clinical accuracy.
* 3
  
  Self-Referral Access
  
  No GP letter needed. Book any test directly for your own health information.
* 4
  
  Secure Digital Results
  
  Results delivered via encrypted patient portal with clinical reference ranges.

**Important:** This is a diagnostic testing service only. We do not provide medical advice,
interpretation of results, or treatment. Please consult your GP or a specialist if you need clinical
guidance based on your results.

## Why Choose Private Blood Tests in London?

When you need reliable diagnostic testing without the long NHS waiting times, **Private Blood Tests
London** offers a faster, more convenient alternative. Our CQC-registered clinic in South Kensington
provides access to over 1,000 blood tests, all processed at UKAS-accredited laboratories that meet
the same ISO 15189 standards used by NHS hospital pathology departments.

Unlike NHS services where you typically need a GP referral and may wait weeks for an appointment,
our private blood testing service operates on a self-referral basis. This means you can book any
test directly – whether you want to check your [thyroid function][24], monitor [cholesterol
levels][25], assess [diabetes markers like HbA1c][26], or investigate fatigue with iron studies and
vitamin panels.

### Same-Day Appointments & Fast Results

We understand that when you're concerned about your health, waiting isn't an option. That's why we
offer same-day and next-day blood test appointments at our South Kensington clinic, subject to
availability. Most routine blood tests return results within 24-48 hours, delivered securely via our
encrypted patient portal. Specialist tests such as hormone panels, allergy testing, and cancer
markers typically take 3-5 working days.

### Professional Clinical Standards

Every blood sample at our London clinic is collected by NMC-registered nurses and phlebotomists in a
clean, clinical environment. We partner with TDL (The Doctors Laboratory), one of the UK's leading
clinical laboratories that serves Harley Street consultants, private hospitals, and healthcare
providers across London. This ensures your results are accurate, reliable, and clinically
meaningful.

# Understand your lab tests, understand your health

At Testing.com, we help consumers advocate for their health by providing them with learning guides
and products that make lab testing accessible, convenient and affordable.

Hundreds of easy-to-read lab testing guides. Confidential, secure and convenient online lab test
ordering powered by direct access to our laboratory partners. Compassionate customer support. We
combine expert-reviewed lab test information with access to hundreds of in-lab and at-home tests.

Testing.com is supported by readers and we may also earn commissions through products purchased
using links on this page. You can read more about how we make money [here][50].

[ Show all tests ][51]
[Home Page Banner Image]

## How it Works

### It’s all about the data.

Lab testing provides the data you need to build and maintain a care plan that is as custom and
convenient as possible. Read over 400 expert-reviewed lab test guides to better understand what each
test measures, how it’s used, when you might need a particular test, and more.

[View Testing Guides][52]
[How it Works Image 1]

### Turn information into action.

If you need a test, order lab tests and at-home test kits through our laboratory partners directly.
We partner with certified labs to give you the most reliable and secure experience possible.

[How it Works Image 2]

### Make informed health care decisions

Most results are ready 1-2 days after samples are received at the laboratory. Your results will be
accessible through the partnering laboratory or company that your order is processed through.

[View Resources][53]

### Explore your treatment options

Your results are a starting point, not the finish line. Our expert-reviewed treatment guides walk
through the options, from GLP-1 medications for weight and blood sugar to sermorelin and NAD+ for
energy and recovery.

[View Treatments][54]

# Understand your lab tests, understand your health

At Testing.com, we help consumers advocate for their health by providing them with learning guides
and products that make lab testing accessible, convenient and affordable.

Hundreds of easy-to-read lab testing guides. Confidential, secure and convenient online lab test
ordering powered by direct access to our laboratory partners. Compassionate customer support. We
combine expert-reviewed lab test information with access to hundreds of in-lab and at-home tests.

Testing.com is supported by readers and we may also earn commissions through products purchased
using links on this page. You can read more about how we make money [here][50].

### It’s all about the data.

Lab testing provides the data you need to build and maintain a care plan that is as custom and
convenient as possible. Read over 400 expert-reviewed lab test guides to better understand what each
test measures, how it’s used, when you might need a particular test, and more.

### Turn information into action.

If you need a test, order lab tests and at-home test kits through our laboratory partners directly.
We partner with certified labs to give you the most reliable and secure experience possible.

### Make informed health care decisions

Most results are ready 1-2 days after samples are received at the laboratory. Your results will be
accessible through the partnering laboratory or company that your order is processed through.

### Explore your treatment options

Your results are a starting point, not the finish line. Our expert-reviewed treatment guides walk
through the options, from GLP-1 medications for weight and blood sugar to sermorelin and NAD+ for
energy and recovery.

### [Reference Ranges and What They Mean][91]

A reference range is a set of values that includes upper and lower limits of a lab test based on a
group of otherwise healthy people. By comparing your test results with reference values, you and
your health care provider can see if any of your test results fall outside the range of expected
values and gain clues to help identify possible conditions or diseases.

## Antibiotic-Resistant Bacteria Cause More Deaths than HIV or Malaria

A new global report found that more people died of infections caused by antibiotic-resistant
bacteria than HIV or malaria in 2019. Bacterial infections that don’t respond to antibiotic
treatment are a serious public health threat. Misuse and overuse of antibiotics have contributed to
this increasing worldwide problem.
